rows.source: 剛剛提過的任意孔形之外，自交與各處最小壁厚也還沒驗。
rows.proposal: Those arbitrary hole shapes, self-intersections and minimum wall thickness everywhere remain unchecked.
rows.reason: Those supplies the callback to previously-mentioned arbitrary hole shapes; shared remain unchecked preserves the negative scope for arbitrary holes, self-intersections and minimum wall thickness everywhere.

rows.source: 漂亮的三維預覽，離可用的零件還差哪一步？
rows.proposal: 美しい3Dプレビューを使える部品にするには、何が足りませんか。
rows.suggested: 美しい3Dプレビューを使える部品にするには何が必要ですか。
rows.reason: 何が足りませんか is not a natural open question here; use a polite what-is-needed question retaining the beautiful3D-preview→usable-part gap.

rows.source: 那改看網格是不是封閉，會不會比較可靠？
rows.proposal: では、メッシュが閉じているかを見れば、より確かですか。
rows.reason: 閉じているか explicitly retains whether closure holds; the whole check is posed as a question about reliability.

rows.source: 漂亮的三維預覽，離可用的零件還差哪一步？
rows.proposal: ¿Qué separa una bella vista previa 3D de una pieza útil?
rows.reason: Bella3D preview and useful part remain the two ends of the question; qué separa is a concise natural rendering of the missing step.

rows.source: 如果這一步足夠，填滿中央的反例應該也會被擋住。
rows.proposal: Si bastara, debería rechazar también el contraejemplo de centro relleno.
rows.reason: Conditional sufficiency, should reject, also and the filled-center counterexample remain.

rows.source: 內圈裡是空的；填孔反例只剩外圈，中心仍然有材料。
rows.proposal: Dentro del aro hay vacío; el contraejemplo solo deja aro exterior y centro con material.
rows.suggested: El contorno interno encierra vacío; el contraejemplo solo tiene el externo y centro lleno.
rows.reason: aro introduces an ambiguous physical ring where the preceding line and slide describe inner/outer contours; keep the established contour distinction and center filled with material.

rows.source: 剛剛提過的任意孔形之外，自交與各處最小壁厚也還沒驗。
rows.proposal: Por revisar: agujeros de cualquier forma ya citados, autointersecciones y grosor mínimo en toda pared.
rows.reason: Por revisar makes all three limitations pending; arbitrary shapes already cited, self-intersections and minimum thickness throughout every wall remain.

rows.source: 如果這一步足夠，填滿中央的反例應該也會被擋住。
rows.proposal: Se bastasse, também deveria barrar o contraexemplo de centro cheio.
rows.reason: Se bastasse remains conditional; deveria retains should, também retains also, centro cheio identifies the intentionally filled-center counterexample.

rows.source: 兩份相同外形的模型，現在一起送進這項檢查。
rows.proposal: Agora testamos juntos os dois modelos de mesma forma externa.
rows.reason: Both models, same outer shape, now and together are explicit; first-person test voice is supported by the narrator performing this original demonstration.

rows.source: 剛剛提過的任意孔形之外，自交與各處最小壁厚也還沒驗。
rows.proposal: Por testar: furos de qualquer forma já citados, autointerseções e espessura mínima em toda parede.
rows.reason: Por testar preserves untested status for all listed items; arbitrary hole shapes already cited, self-intersections and minimum wall thickness everywhere remain.

rows.source: 漂亮的三維預覽，離可用的零件還差哪一步？
rows.proposal: Langkah apa dari pratinjau 3D cantik ke komponen layak pakai?
rows.reason: A missing step from a beautiful3D preview to a usable component remains a question; no claim that the preview is physically usable is added.

rows.source: 它不是拿一百個零件去列印，有幾個能用的成功率。
rows.proposal: Ini bukan persentase dari 100 komponen cetak yang layak pakai.
rows.reason: bukan preserves negation; persentase dari100komponen cetak yang layak pakai keeps100printed components as the denominator and usable count as numerator. This is explicitly what the metric is NOT.

rows.source: 如果這一步足夠，填滿中央的反例應該也會被擋住。
rows.proposal: Jika ini cukup, contoh tandingan bertengah terisi pun mestinya ditolak.
rows.suggested: Jika ini cukup, contoh tandingan dengan tengah terisi pun mestinya ditolak.
rows.reason: bertengah terisi is an unnatural compressed construction; dengan tengah terisi keeps the filled center explicitly and natural conditional/should-rejection.

rows.source: 兩份相同外形的模型，現在一起送進這項檢查。
rows.proposal: Kini kedua model berbentuk luar sama diperiksa bersama.
rows.suggested: Kini kedua model dengan bentuk luar sama diuji bersama.
rows.reason: berbentuk luar sama is awkward; with the same outer shape is clear and still sends both models through the test together now.

rows.source: 那改看網格是不是封閉，會不會比較可靠？
rows.proposal: Kalau mengecek mesh tertutup, apa lebih andal?
rows.suggested: Kalau cek apakah mesh tertutup, lebih andal?
rows.reason: The proposed mengecek mesh tertutup can mean inspecting an already-closed mesh; source asks whether the mesh is closed. Restore apakah without asserting the result.

rows.source: 填孔反例的觀察線，則全部被擋住。
rows.proposal: Pada contoh lubang terisi, semua garis pengamatan terhalang.
rows.reason: All observation lines blocked is explicit. contoh lubang terisi refers to the same intentionally-filled counterexample already introduced in o8jk/dag4 and does not relabel it as a Kimi output.

rows.source: 剛剛提過的任意孔形之外，自交與各處最小壁厚也還沒驗。
rows.proposal: Bentuk lubang sembarang tadi, perpotongan diri, dan tebal minimum tiap titik dinding belum diuji.
rows.reason: tadi preserves the earlier arbitrary-hole callback; perpotongan diri and minimum thickness at each wall point remain untested. No manufacturing guarantee is introduced.

rows.source: 漂亮的三維預覽，離可用的零件還差哪一步？
rows.proposal: Từ bản xem trước 3D đẹp tới chi tiết dùng được, thiếu bước nào?
rows.reason: Beautiful3D preview→usable part, and which step is missing, remain natural in standard Vietnamese.

verdict: ready after five corrections and a fresh native pure caption preview; not dub acceptance
